clips.title: The story
paras: Foreman's Blackjack keeps peons at work in Durotar's Valley of Trials. Foremen use the leather-wrapped cosh to wake laborers who fall asleep during the Horde's early construction.

Durotar's rugged desert needs stockpiles of lumber for the Horde's new home. In the Valley of Trials, the work falls to the peons, and Foreman Thazz'ril keeps the crews moving with Foreman's Blackjack. The weighted bludgeon delivers a jarring wake-up call to laborers caught napping beneath the valley's shade trees, rather than a lethal blow. Peon life in the new Horde means grueling, unglamorous work under an iron fist.
